_note: One non-violent Money Monster per boss region, four total as of Stage 6, each tied to a goal/streak/level milestone. 'unlock' is shaped exactly like an item's unlock so unlocks.js's isItemUnlocked() handles the gating with no new code. The encounter is always the same calm-down memory sequence (breathe/count/wait/smile, reused and reordered/lengthened per boss for variety and difficulty) — never combat. Winning means the monster learns patience, not that it's defeated violently.

bosses.name: Impulse Imp
bosses.flavor: The Impulse Imp zips around whispering "buy it now, buy it now!" Help it slow down by showing it how to calm down.
bosses.winFlavor: The Impulse Imp takes a deep breath... and smiles. "Maybe I don't need it right now," it says.

bosses.name: Sneaky Subscription
bosses.flavor: The Sneaky Subscription keeps quietly renewing itself, hoping nobody notices. Help it learn to ask first.
bosses.winFlavor: The Sneaky Subscription blushes. "You're right — I should always ask before I renew," it admits.

bosses.name: Fee Phantom
bosses.flavor: The Fee Phantom nibbles tiny bits off every jar it can find, one sneaky fee at a time.
bosses.winFlavor: The Fee Phantom floats away quietly. "I'll let your rainy-day fund rest in peace," it sighs.

bosses.name: Inflation Dragon
bosses.flavor: The Inflation Dragon makes everything cost a little more every year, just by breathing on it. The closer you get to your goal, the louder it roars.
bosses.winFlavor: The Inflation Dragon curls up and purrs. "A patient saver always outlasts me," it rumbles.
